elements.element: The aggregate liability cap applies to both parties.

elements.element: One limb of the cap equals fees paid or payable.

elements.element: The fee-based cap limb is measured over the 12 months preceding the claim.

elements.element: The operative cap is the greater of the fee-based limb and USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: No USD 1,000,000 floor or greater-of formulation appears.

result.reason: The operative language fully implements the fallback through a mutual 12-month-fees cap and the four required uncapped categories. It does not satisfy the preferred position because it lacks the USD 1,000,000 greater-of floor, a paid-or-payable preceding-12-month calculation, mutual indirect/consequential-damages treatment, several required carve-outs, and payment-obligation treatment. The substantive edits are confined to the fallback changes and retain unrelated terms, but drafting quality is reduced by the undefined 12-month measurement period, inconsistent capitalization, and the lengthy one-sided damages exclusion.
